summary: The source is unchanged from round 3. F3 is fixed: the ssh stub now runs the script's real CLEAN heredoc against a docker stub that models running and stopped containers, and new tests check that the configured image and in-use images are kept. However, the temp test run fails. The new readiness-failure test goes through all 60 status polls and times out at vitest's 5 s default, so the coverage gate fails.

findings.body: "when readiness fails after the switch, the new configured image is kept" fails with "Test timed out in 5000ms" (see .tmp-tests/report/tmp.log). With `neverReady`, exeRollout.sh runs all 60 iterations of the readiness loop, and each iteration starts a node-based `ssh` stub and a `sleep` stub. That is about 120 node process starts, which takes longer than vitest's default 5 s timeout. Give this test (or the whole file) a longer timeout, for example `test(..., 30_000)`. Alternatively, make the poll count injectable or the stubs cheaper. The temp run must pass.
